```yaml
name: Build Snapshot
on:
  workflow_call:
    outputs:
      snapshot_name:
        description: "The name of the built snapshot"
        value: ${{ jobs.build_snapshot.outputs.snapshot_name }}

jobs:
  build_snapshot:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      snapshot_name: ${{ steps.set_snapshot_name.outputs.snapshot_name }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set snapshot name
        id: set_snapshot_name
        run: |
          COMMIT_HASH=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
          SNAPSHOT_NAME="iterate-sandbox-${COMMIT_HASH}"
          echo "snapshot_name=${SNAPSHOT_NAME}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "Snapshot name set to: ${SNAPSHOT_NAME}"

      - name: Validate commit hash length
        run: |
          COMMIT_HASH=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
          if [ ${#COMMIT_HASH} -ne 40 ]; then
            echo "Error: Commit hash is not 40 characters long"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Commit hash is valid: ${COMMIT_HASH}"

      - name: Build snapshot
        run: |
          COMMIT_HASH=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
          echo "Building snapshot for commit: ${COMMIT_HASH}"
          # Add actual snapshot building commands here
          echo "Snapshot built successfully with name: iterate-sandbox-${COMMIT_HASH}"
```
